results.snippet:
The change in demand followed a 2024 decision to place countervailing duties of up to 45.3% on battery electric vehicles imported from China.

That pushed some buyers toward new plug-in hybrid electric vehicles and used battery EVs since neither category was covered by the extra duties.

The European Union will cap Chinese hybrid car imports at 350,000 units annually, down from an expected 800,000 without limits. This four-year agreement aims to reduce China’s market share from 6% to 3%. Brussels views this measure as cutting imports by over half, whereas Beijing sees room for growth against 2025 levels.
